names.name: CopyProtection__Is_Launcher_Running
names.evidence: Its debug message is "COPYPROTECTION - Checking if launcher is running"; it uses the name 48BC11BD-C4D7-466b-8A31-C6ABBAD47B3E, as Yuri's Revenge's 0x0049F5C0 does. One caller.

names.name: CopyProtection__Notify_Launcher
names.evidence: Its debug messages are "COPYPROTECTION - Notify launcher", "Launcher notified." and "***** Failed to notify launcher!"; it uses the name D6E7FC97-64F9-4d28-B52C-754EDF721C6F, as Yuri's Revenge's 0x0049F620 does.

names.name: Init__Boot_Screen
names.evidence: Uses GLS.PAL, GLSS.SHP, GLSL.SHP, TXT_COPYRIGHT and GUI:WWBrand; an assert names Init.CPP. It is the call at 0x00511808 that run_lift.py's ra2_startup_order_patches moves. Yuri's Revenge's is 0x005312A0.

names.name: Movie__Play_Movie
names.evidence: Prints "Play_Movie() as Bink!" and "Stretching movie %dx%d -> %dx%d" and uses the extension ".bik". 27 callers, the start-up logo's among them (0x0051269A and 0x005126EE, run_lift.py's RA2_STARTUP_ORDER). 0x005A1D30 prints the same first message without the stretch and stays unnamed. Yuri's Revenge's is 0x005BED40.

names.name: Math__ftol
names.evidence: The same 61 bytes as Yuri's Revenge's 0x007C5F00 apart from the global's address, 0x007D8964 here: fnstcw [esp]; cmp the control word with the global; when they differ, fldcw it and leave it loaded; fistp qword; return edx:eax.

names.name: CRT__chkstk
names.evidence: The same 47 bytes as Yuri's Revenge's 0x007CA650, and the only place in game.exe's code they occur: MSVC 6's stack probe, eax the frame size.
